theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs
  refine ⟨.choice h, fun s1 s2 hr μ => ?_⟩
  cases hr
  case bisim hb =>
    refine ⟨fun _ htr => ?_, fun _ htr => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hr'⟩ := hb.follow_fst htr
      exact ⟨y, hy, .bisim hr'⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hr'⟩ := hb.follow_snd htr
      exact ⟨y, hy, .bisim hr'⟩
  case choice hb =>
    refine ⟨fun _ htr => ?_, fun _ htr => ?_⟩
    · cases htr
      case choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hr'⟩ := hb.follow_fst htr
        exact ⟨y, .choiceL hy, .bisim hr'⟩
      case choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨_, .choiceR htr, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    · cases htr
      case choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hr'⟩ := hb.follow_snd htr
        exact ⟨y, .choiceL hy, .bisim hr'⟩
      case choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨_, .choiceR htr, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
